metadata.description:
Measurement tables behind Lopez & Lacy, "Evidence for strong shocks in the ISM of small radio sources" (submitted to ApJL).

Two samples of radio-loud AGN were drawn from a cross-match of the VLA Sky Survey (VLASS) with DESI DR1 spectroscopy over 0.15 < z < 0.5, both cut to log10(L_3GHz / W Hz^-1) > 24. The small sample (n = 47) has projected jet sizes of 10-15 kpc and is still confined within the host galaxy; the large sample (n = 30) has jets larger than 25 kpc that have escaped the host. Both samples are given in a single table of 77 rows, keyed by TARGETID, with a sample column separating them. For each source the table gives VLASS radio properties (flux density, angular and linear size, spectral index, luminosity distance, 3 GHz luminosity), DESI DR1 agngal value-added catalog emission line fluxes and inverse variances ([NeV] 3426, [OI] 6300, [OIII] 5007, H-alpha narrow and broad, H-beta), the paper's own pyspeckit Gaussian line fluxes for H-beta, [OIII] 5007, H-alpha, [NII] 6584 and [OI] 6300 with the two BPT line ratios derived from them, the [OIII] 5007 W80 line width with the instrumental resolution removed, and the BPT classification with its perpendicular distance from the Seyfert/LINER dividing line.

Also included are the scripts that build the table and produce the paper figures, a machine-readable column description, and a check script that reproduces every statistic quoted in the paper from the released table alone.

The DESI DR1 spectra and VLASS images are not redistributed here. They are public and can be retrieved via the DESI Data Release 1 archive or NOIRLab SPARCL using the TARGETID column.
